Set the Smoke Test stage timeout in the Jenkinsfile to exceed the smoke test's maximum wait with margin (e.g. 3 minutes for a 90s wait), ideally driven from the same value as the script's wait setting. Also confirm why the service needs about 90s to become healthy, since that may be the real problem.
